episodes.165804: A large complex of thunderstorms moved across all of Central Florida, and produced many strong wind gusts along the east Florida Atlantic coast from Brevard to Saint Lucie Counties.
episodes.166311: A weakening cold front attempting to push through West Central Florida produced a line a line of showers. Most of the showers were weak but one isolated thunderstorm within the line produced a strong marine wind gust.
episodes.166500: A departing upper trough and afternoon heating were two factors in causing heavy showers and isolated thunderstorms over Maui, the Big Island, and Oahu.  The rain produced small stream and drainage ditch flooding, and ponding on roadways.  No serious property damage or injuries were reported.
